answer.summary: A narrow research question is proposed to investigate explicit memory retention thresholds in tokenized agents under periodic input with known perturbations, focusing solely on reported retention metrics from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1.
answer.content: Propose a new, narrow research question: 'What is the minimum token budget required for observable memory retention in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, when anchored exclusively to the explicitly reported per-interval retention rate in Section 4.1 of Kumar et al., 2024?' This query targets a measurable, data-anchored outcome without extending beyond available source metrics or introducing unreported dynamics.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to formulate a revised research question on the minimum token budget required for observable memory retention in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, anchored solely to the per-interval retention rate metric explicitly reported in Section 4.1 of 'Stability and Forgetting in Autoregressive Models' by Kumar et al., 2024
answer.lesson: Memory research must anchor exclusively to explicitly reported metrics; unreported or inferred dynamics introduce unverifiable assumptions and risk invalid conclusions in evidence-limited environments.
